questions.text: Who is the author of the Islamic book titled 'Al-Fozul Kabir'?
questions.explanation: The Islamic book 'Al-Fozul Kabir' was authored by Shah Wali Ullah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Who compiled Anwar-ut-Tanzil?
questions.explanation: Anwar-ut-Tanzil was compiled by Qazi Nasiruddin Abu Said Baidhawi. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers.

questions.text: Who compiled the famous Islamic exegesis Tafseer-i-Tabri?
questions.explanation: Tafseer-i-Tabri was compiled by Abu Jafar Muhammad Ibn Tabri (also known as Imam Tabari), one of the earliest and most comprehensive commentaries on the Holy Quran. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers.

questions.text: Who is the author of the book 'Tarjuman-ul-Quran'?
questions.explanation: The book 'Tarjuman-ul-Quran' was authored by Abul Kalam Azad. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers.

questions.text: Which renowned Tafseer was authored by Mufti Muhammad Shafi?
questions.explanation: The renowned Tafseer authored by Mufti Muhammad Shafi is Maarif ul Quran. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers.

questions.text: Who compiled the famous work 'Mufradat'?
questions.explanation: The famous work 'Mufradat' (Mufradat al-Quran / Mufradat fi Gharib al-Quran) was compiled by Abul Qasim Husain Raghib Isphahani. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers.

questions.text: Who is the author of the famous Islamic book Tafseer al Quran al Azeem?
questions.explanation: The author of the famous Tafseer al-Quran al-Azeem is Ismail bin Kathir (Ibn Kathir). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, famous tafseers.

questions.text: During whose caliphate was the Quran compiled into a book form?
questions.explanation: The Quran was compiled into a book form during the caliphate of Hazrat Abu Bakr Siddique (R.A). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, history of compilation (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Who was responsible for introducing punctuation marks in the written text of the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: Note: Hajjaj bin Yusuf is credited with adding dots and diacritics, building on Abu al-Aswad al-Du'ali's earlier work. Punctuation marks (I'raab/diacritical marks) in the written text of the Holy Quran were introduced by Hujjaj bin Yousuf. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, history of compilation.

questions.text: Which Surah was the first to be revealed to the Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The first Surah revealed to the Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was Surah al-Alaq (the first five verses). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What should be recited before starting the recitation of the Quran?
questions.explanation: Before reciting the Quran, one should recite Ta'awwudh (A'udhu Billahi min ash-Shaytan ir-Rajim) and Tasmiyah (Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Rahim). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith.

questions.text: What is the role of the Quran in relation to the previous divine books?
questions.explanation: The Quran serves as a confirmation (Musaddiq) of the previous divine scriptures, verifying the truth that was revealed in them. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith.

questions.text: Which language was the Holy Quran first translated into within the subcontinent?
questions.explanation: The Holy Quran was first translated into Sindhi within the subcontinent. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith.

questions.text: During which night is it believed that the Quran was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The Quran was revealed to the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) on the night of Lailat ul Qadr (the Night of Power/Decree). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith.

questions.text: Who is the Quran revealed by according to Islamic belief?
questions.explanation: According to Islamic belief, the Quran is revealed by Allah Almighty. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith.

questions.text: Who was the first person to translate the Holy Quran into French?
questions.explanation: The first person to translate the Holy Quran into French was Du Ryer. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, introduction to quran hadith.

questions.text: What is the shortest Surah in the Holy Quran?
questions.explanation: The shortest Surah in the Holy Quran is Surah Al-Kausar, consisting of only 3 verses. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, surahs ayat contents of the quran (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What does Surah Al-Muzammil refer to in terms of its meaning?
questions.explanation: Surah Al-Muzammil means "The Wrapped in garments" referring to the Prophet (PBUH) being wrapped in his mantle. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, surahs ayat contents of the quran.

questions.text: In which Surah does Allah refer to the wives of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as mothers of the believers?
questions.explanation: In Surah Al-Ahzab (33:6), Allah refers to the wives of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ as "mothers of the believers" (Ummahat-ul-Momineen). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, surahs ayat contents of the quran.
